description: Reports the results of each outreach campaign in the workspace (people contacted, replies, meetings, credits spent); Nock calls each campaign with its signals a "motor", a prospecting playbook. Read-only. How the motors are doing ("como estão os motores?"): every campaign of the workspace as a motor, for the last 7, 30 or 90 days. Per motor: people added, people first contacted in the period, replies, positive replies (null while replies are not classified), meetings (null when the workspace never recorded one), credits spent, credits per positive reply, and the reply rate by channel (e-mail vs LinkedIn). Rates are percentages of the people first contacted in the period. Also the reply and positive rates by signal family and by the most common signal combinations for people that came from compound signals; with fewer than 20 people a rate is left out and marked "amostra pequena" (never present it as a result). Targets: 5% replies, 2% positive; below 2% replies after 150 first touches the motor should be rewritten or turned off. When the weekly learning is on, `learning` has last week's verdict per motor and weight suggestions for compound blocks (never applied: only the user changes a weight). Free, reads only.
name: motor_report
title: Ver o relatório por motor
